relationships.subject: DRG Trpv1+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, we demonstrated that activation of Trpv1+ neurons in the DRG was necessary and sufficient to induce a decrease in RORγ+ Tregs.

relationships.subject: vagal Trpv1+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: By contrast, activation of Trpv1+ vagal neurons did not affect this population.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice treated with intrathecal injection of RTX had greatly diminished DREADD-mCherry expression in the DRG, while sparing those neurons in the NG (Fig. 6H).

relationships.subject: Nos1+ nitrergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Nos1+ nitrergic neuron activation specifically downregulated RORγ+ CD4+ T conventional (Th17-like) cells in the ileum compared to CTRLs (Fig. 2A)

relationships.subject: Chat+ cholinergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas Chat+ cholinergic neuron activation downregulated ileal neutrophils (Fig. 2B)

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuroanatomical, genetic, and pharmacological follow-up showed that Trpv1+ neurons in dorsal root ganglia decreased Treg cell numbers via the neuropeptide calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP).

key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of DRG Trpv1+ nociceptors is necessary and sufficient to reduce gut RORγ+ Tregs, while vagal Trpv1+ neurons have no effect.
Trpv1+ neuron activation worsened DSS colitis and Citrobacter rodentium infection; effect is mediated via CGRP.
